html:
This week ED visits related to COVID (SARS-CoV-2) and influenza increased somewhat compared to recent weeks. Visits identified through syndromic surveillance related to influenza constituted approximately 1.2% of total visits. Visits related to respiratory sysncytial virus (RSV) continue to be low.

COVID virus levels are currently High in sampled wastewater in Lawrence. Influenza A virus levels are also high while Influenza B continues to be low. Levels of RSV are also low.

The best way to prevent respiratory illness is by getting vaccinated. Please call 785-843-0721 to schedule your appointment.

Everyone can take action to reduce the spread of respiratory viruses!
  • Practice good hygiene by covering your coughs and sneezes.
  • Wash your hands often.
  • Clean frequently touched surfaces.
  • Stay home when you're sick.
